title: Loop 2 — Routed Context variations
meta: A Hard Dock · B Pipe First · C Typographic Route · D Asymmetric Route. Same grammar: inputs → teal pipe → output + lowercase ctx.

items.name: Hard Dock
items.blurb: Inlets physically join the pipe. Longer teal stdout. Three-in / one-out is literal.

items.name: Pipe First
items.blurb: Heavier, taller teal pipe as the object. Shorter staggered inlets. Pipe is not a divider.

items.name: Typographic Route
items.blurb: 8px stroke shared by mark and letters. Clearly lowercase c, narrow t, open x. No second pipe.

items.name: Asymmetric Route
items.blurb: Long middle inlet, short flanks, stdout dropped off-center. Less hamburger, more direction.
